name: Luxembourg
exam_name: Examination on the "Vivre ensemble au Grand-Duché de Luxembourg" course

fee.covers: The naturalization procedure, which the page says is free of charge.

unverified.exemptions: The minister can grant exemptions from required documents on a reasoned request; nothing specific to the examination was read.

notes: Applicants must either attend the course or pass the test on its topics; the test is one of two ways to meet the condition, not the only one. A Luxembourgish language test is required separately.
